title: fix(plugin-webhooks): gate webhook redelivery on webhook-administration access
body:
Hardening dispatched directly by QA (domain:devx); no tracking issue.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Review owed before the queue: this narrows who may call a public door (`POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver`), so it carries one contract-review-tier review before any seat queues it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Webhook 重投递入口(`POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver`,两个入口面)在登录校验之后、读取请求体之前,先由安全服务判定调用者是否有 Webhook 管理权限(`sys_webhook` 的对象级编辑准入);无权者统一 403,不再接触任何投递记录。
- 为什么改:原先"任何已登录用户都可重投递"只是早期的延后实现("finer RBAC is future work"),并非裁决;重投递是 Webhook 管理动作,入口应与 Webhook 管理权限对齐,且无权调用者不应得到任何记录级细节。
- 风险与回滚:依赖非管理员点重投递的部署会改为 403(迁移:用权限集给其 `sys_webhook` 编辑权);未注册安全服务的部署改为 503。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-entitlement.ts`(判定与失败方向)、`webhook-outbox-plugin.ts` 中 `serveRedeliver` 新增的闸门段、`webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts`,预期 11 个用例全绿(管理员放行、成员 403 且七种请求同一应答、无安全服务或判定抛错 503)。
- 需要你做的:安排一次 contract-review-tier 复核(本 PR 收窄了公开入口的调用者范围)。

## What changes

- **The gate.** `serveRedeliver` (the one body both faces run: the self-hosted raw-app mount and the `webhooks` slot's `handleRedeliver`) now asks, right after the auth gate and the `401`, and before the request body is read, whether the signed-in caller may administer webhooks. New module `redeliver-entitlement.ts`:
  - the caller's `ExecutionContext` comes from `resolveRequestExecutionContext` (the one platform composition), fed the session the door already read (`session: { established }`), so the gate judges exactly the identity the door acts as, with no second session read;
  - the decision is `ISecurityService.explain({ object: 'sys_webhook', operation: 'update' }, context).allowed`, the same admission the data API's write gate gives that caller (ADR-0124 D1: server-side);
  - refused: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, one fixed answer, so nothing in it depends on a delivery row; no security service, or a check that throws: `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (fail closed, cause logged at `error`).
- **Why update on `sys_webhook`, not read on `sys_http_delivery`.** Replaying a delivery is a write-shaped act (the row resets and a signed request goes out), the same power as editing or re-activating the subscription; a read-only principal holding a read wildcard must not gain it.
- **Unchanged for an entitled caller:** the ADR-0069 gate, `401`, the `400` body refusals, active-organization scoping (`404` outside it), the redelivery veto's `409`s, the `200` replay. The door still admits no API key (`webhook-redeliver-api-key.pin.test.ts` green, untouched).
- **Docs and records.** `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` section 8 states the gate; checklist items `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle` (r12: the old posture sentence replaced, the redeliver clause is driven as the seeded admin) and `integration-system.notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility` (r4: steps[2] names the admin persona, `automated.ref` adds the new suite); the dogfood authz matrix row's summary; a stale comment in `http-delivery.object.ts`; the engine-double ledger row for the new suite; a `patch` changeset with the migration line.

## Tests

Plugin suite at final head `957b96882b`: `Test Files 24 passed (24) · Tests 242 passed (242)`; typecheck (tsc + test-layer) exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.

- New `webhook-redeliver-entitlement.test.ts` (11 cases, both faces, real `LiteKernel` + real `MessagingService` + `MemoryHttpOutbox`, a `security` double answering the gate's one question): an administrator replays and the gate was asked about that caller; control: the administrator still gets the inactive-subscription `409`; a non-administrator gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with one identical body across seven requests (own-org finished delivery, other org's, inactive subscription, gone subscription, unknown id, missing id, non-JSON body), no delivery id, subscription id or webhook name in it, `redeliverHttp` never called, every row still `dead`; anonymous stays `401` and the gate is never asked; no security service / a throwing decision: `503`, nothing replayed.
- Existing door suites (`webhook-redeliver-member`, `-tenant-scope`, `-auth-gate.pin`, `in-process-session-read.pin`, http-conformance `hono-webhooks-redeliver`) register a security double admitting their callers; their assertions are unchanged.
- Ablation (one-time, not kept): with the refusal branch disabled through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob `0af6f1c8` → `43aa6ea5`), the new suite went `6 failed | 5 passed (11)` (both refusal cases and all four fail-closed cases red, the admit cases green); restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `tryGetService(['security'])` treats a throwing lookup as absent, so a kernel that never registered `security` answers `503` with a remedy, never a silent admit. The analytics read admission takes the same direction.
- The gate is asked of `sys_webhook` (this plugin's configuration object), not of a host-renamed `subscriptionsObject`: administration of the plugin's own object governs the door.
- An organization admin on a wall-less posture resolves `organization_admin_no_bypass`; whether that set reaches `sys_webhook` is decided by the security service exactly as it is for `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_webhook/:id`, by construction.

## Verification

Live readings on a fresh showcase boot of this branch (`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT --seed-admin`, full `pnpm build` green, 114/114 tasks), member minted by the admin and password changed so the session is not held; summarised by status, not transcribed:

- the member: `403` on `GET` of both `sys_http_delivery` and `sys_webhook` (the baseline the gate mirrors); `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` from the redeliver door for a real finished same-org delivery, for that delivery once its webhook was switched off, for an unknown id and for a non-JSON body, all the same body; the local sink received no second POST;
- the seeded admin: `409 DELIVERY_NOT_ELIGIBLE` for the switched-off webhook, `404` for an unknown id, `400` for a non-JSON body, then `200 {status: pending}` after re-activation, and the sink received the replay (second POST, same byte length);
- anonymous: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.
